title: Machine Learning Engineer - Remote Work
description:
At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.

Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.

When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.

Machine Learning Engineer at BairesDev

We are looking for an outstanding Machine Learning Engineer to join our team. This professional will use data and machine learning techniques to help the business automate and scale decision-making, mainly by producing advanced data analysis reports and data-based models to infer and predict patterns.

What You Will Do:

  • Help to improve data literacy and the overall analytical environment across the company.
  • Handle both structured and unstructured data using SQL and other programming languages.
  • Perform advanced data analysis and report results.
  • Tell the story behind data in a compelling manner for business people.
  • Build predictive models and machine-learning algorithms.
  • Combine models through ensemble modeling.
  • Propose solutions and strategies to business challenges.
  • Help to design and execute experiments for hypothesis testing.
  • Participate actively in discussions and decisions regarding the whole Machine Learning / Data Science chapter.
  • Collaborate with data product managers to build awesome data products.
  • Work with management to prioritize business and information needs.
  • Help to spread a data-driven mindset and to improve data literacy. Be a data evangelist.

Here’s what we are looking for:

  • 3+ years of experience with Machine Learning, data science, IA, statistical, and other related areas.
  • Proficiency with MySQL.
  • Proficiency in Python, R, or another major programming language.
  • Excellent communication skills, and capacity to collaborate and build relationships with non-technical users.
  • Strong knowledge of probability and statistics, including experimental design, predictive modeling, optimization, and causal inference.
  • Hands-on experience with machine learning, like regression classification, clustering, neural networks, feature selection, cross-validation, the curse of dimensionality, bias-variance tradeoff, model explainability, NLP, etc.
  • Experience with people analytics or growth.
  • Experience with data visualization tools.
  • Good understanding of the engineering challenges to deploying machine learning systems to production.

How we do make your work (and your life) easier:

  • 100% remote work (from anywhere).
  • Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred.
  • Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.
  • Flexible hours: create your own schedule.
  • Paid parental leaves, vacations, and national holidays.
  • Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.
  • Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.

Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive!

description:

Array Technologies, Inc. is a global leader in solar energy solutions – and we have been for over 30 years! Our dramatic growth is creating incredible opportunities on our dynamic, innovative and

creative team. Are you self-motivated, highly-skilled and possess previous Cyber Security / Information Security experience?

What you’ll do:

The engineer will be a key member in maturing the IT and OT Security organization. They will be part of a global security team that provides support for all areas of Information Security. A successful candidate will have experience with and/or strong interest in becoming a subject matter expert in multiple Security disciplines. These include Zero Trust Architecture, Application and Cloud Security, IAM and/or Data Protection/DLP. Additionally, the engineer will be a point of escalation for investigating and remediating potential threats. The engineer will continuously be apprised of emerging technologies, threats, attacks, and countermeasures and recommend enhancements based on industry best practices. You will:

  • Design, document, test, maintain, and provide issue resolution recommendations for security solutions related to Zero Trust tools, secure software development, cloud, access, authentication/directory services, email, and/or endpoint security.
  • Work with various departments to design, implementation, and maintain IAM policy.
  • Contribute to the development and maintenance of Zero Trust Architecture and SASE tools.
  • Partner with Dev teams to define, execute, and continuously improve our secure software development processes.
  • Partner with IT and Product teams to assess, document and develop Cloud Security best practices.
  • Participates in security incident response activities, conducts technical investigation of security-related incidents and conducts post-incident digital forensics to identify causes and recommend future mitigation strategies.
  • Identifies security vulnerabilities/issues, performs risk assessments, and evaluates remediation alternatives.
  • Contributes to the development and maintenance of information security architecture.
  • Collaborates with other IT teams such as infrastructure and application development in the protection of the company’s IT assets including network, servers, applications, and 3rd party service providers.
  • Contributes to the development of ongoing information security policies and procedures, and ensures such policies and procedures are put into practice in the day-to-day operations of the company’s technology environment.

The qualifications you must have:

  • Some Experience with IAM, SASE, SSDLC, SIEM/SOAR, EDR, EPP
  • Knowledge of Cybersecurity architectures and methodologies (OWASP, Github Advanced Security, Azure DevOps, Zero Trust, NIST, Defense in depth, Kill-Chain, etc.)
  • Knowledge of Secure Cloud Architecture, Vulnerability Management, and Incident Response
  • Familiar with Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Data Protection, and Disaster Recovery
  • Familiar with network/security (IDS/IPS, firewalls, DNS, DHCP)
  • Technical knowledge of Microsoft and Linux

Our preferred qualifications:

  • Cyber Security certifications.
  • 5-10 years of IT industry experience with 3-5 years of those in a role directly related to information security and IT compliance disciplines such as app security, cloud security, IAM, DLP, SASE, etc.
  • Strong subject matter expertise in one or more of technical disciplines such as IT infrastructure, applications development and/or information security.
  • Familiarity with information security disciplines such as privacy protection and data loss prevention.
  • Strong experience in managing cybersecurity incidents and event response.
  • Awareness of industry standards such as ISO, NIST as they relate to information security and protection of privacy.
  • Experience with NERC-CIP standard and polices a plus.
  • Experienced in executing privacy compliance initiatives in response to global privacy regulations such as GDPR and LGPD would be an asset.
  • Knowledge of national and international regulatory compliances and frameworks such as ISO, NIST, and SOX.

Director of Fund Operations – Client Services

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Director of Fund Operations – Client Services to join our Fund Services team in Curaçao. This role is responsible for overseeing the operational, regulatory, and commercial aspects of our Fund Services business, ensuring compliance with statutory, regulatory, and contractual obligations while driving commercial growth. You will lead a team responsible for the set-up and administration of investment funds and their investors, while also playing a key role in business development and client relationship management.

Key Responsibilities

Client Services & Fund Operations

  • Serve as the primary contact for fund administration clients , maintaining strong, long-term relationships and providing expert guidance on structuring, fund operations, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as a technical reference to clients, sales teams, and other offices on fund structuring and operations.
  • Oversee the launch, ongoing administration, and regulatory compliance of a portfolio of funds.
  • Ensure accuracy of NAV calculations, financial reporting, fund transactions, shareholder services, and compliance monitoring .
  • Collaborate with internal accounting teams to ensure accurate and timely delivery of services.

Sales & Business Growth

  • Lead business development efforts to grow the client base and expand services with existing clients.
  • Develop and execute a sales and growth strategy in alignment with office targets.
  • Oversee onboarding and smooth transitions for new fund clients.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure adherence to local and international regulations impacting fund structures and administration.
  • Liaise with regulatory bodies and support clients through audits, examinations, and reporting obligations.
  • Monitor AML/KYC compliance and shareholder services processes.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead and develop a team of fund professionals, fostering high performance and accountability.
  • Oversee productivity, billing, service quality, and operational excellence .
  • Support employee development through training, feedback, and performance management.
  • Continuously review and improve processes to achieve operational efficiencies.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree minimum; 15+ years’ experience in the investment fund industry, ideally with private equity, real estate, or fund administration.
  • Solid technical expertise in fund accounting (IFRS, US GAAP), NAV calculations, capital calls, tax structures, and audit processes .
  • Deep understanding of both UCITS and alternative investment funds .
  • Proven success in leading teams, managing clients, and growing business .
  • Commercially driven, proactive, results-focused.
  • Fluent in English (other languages are an asset).
  • Strong leadership, analytical, and client-facing skills.
  • Hands-on experience with fund structuring, investor services, and fund directorships .

Why Join Us?

  • Work for a global leader in fund administration, compliance, and international structuring .
  • Collaborate with a diverse, international team and prestigious clients.
  • Opportunity to lead and grow a specialized team in a strategic jurisdiction.

Key Responsibilities

As Creative Director, you will be responsible for the following:

  • Shaping the creative vision of the unit and ensuring it is consistently executed across all projects.
  • You will guide multidisciplinary teams through the development of concepts and campaigns, ensuring alignment with the organization’s strategic goals.
  • From brand development and design systems to large-scale integrated campaigns, your leadership will be central in delivering work that is engaging, cohesive, and impactful.
  • You will work closely with senior stakeholders to understand objectives, define creative strategies, and present ideas with clarity and conviction.

We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Sobre a Zippi

A Zippi tem como missão ajudar a impulsionar os 22 milhões de micro e pequenos negócios (MPEs) no Brasil com soluções financeiras que realmente atendem às suas necessidades. Fomos pioneiros no uso do PIX como plataforma de crédito , permitindo que MPEs acessem capital de giro de forma instantânea. Com apenas um toque, nossos clientes conseguem pagar despesas do negócio e ainda contar com até 10 dias para pagar, garantindo um fluxo de caixa mais saudável para suas operações.

Desde o nosso lançamento, alcançamos a lucratividade e experimentamos um crescimento exponencial . Hoje, processamos mais de R$ 3,4 bilhões em pagamentos por ano e estamos escalando rapidamente para nos tornarmos a principal solução de crédito no mercado brasileiro de MPEs, que movimenta cerca de R$ 1,6 trilhão ao ano. Assim como os cartões de crédito transformaram o consumo, a Zippi está redefinindo como os pequenos negócios gerenciam seu fluxo de caixa.

Com o apoio de investidores de alto nível, como Y Combinator e Tiger Global, estamos formando um time de tecnologia de classe mundial para construir um futuro em que todo pequeno negócio no Brasil possa prosperar. Se você busca uma oportunidade de causar impacto real em uma causa que vale a pena , em uma das fintechs que mais cresce em mercados emergentes, enfrentando um desafio multibilionário - a Zippi é o lugar certo pra você.

Sobre o Time

Somos um time coeso e de alta performance sempre com foco em entregar valor para os nossos clientes . Aqui, as pessoas engenheiras possuem um papel estratégico, participando de projetos de alto impacto, focando na geração de valor do produto e na entrega de soluções sustentáveis.

Em parceria direta com produto, design, dados e demais áreas de negócio, garantindo que as pessoas engenheiras tenham contexto amplo para tomar decisões que geram valor real para o negócio da Zippi.

Sua Missão

Na Zippi, sua missão será atuar junto aos times de produto, design, dados e demais áreas de negócio para transformar insights de mercado e necessidades dos nossos usuários em soluções tecnológicas de ponta. Você deverá:

  • Entender as dores e os comportamentos dos MPEs que usam nosso produto, propondo hipóteses de melhoria com base em dados e feedback real.
  • Colaborar em equipes multifuncionais (produto, design, dados, negócios), traduzindo requisitos de negócio em soluções e fluxos de dados que garantam alta performance, escalabilidade e manutenibilidade.
  • Priorizar entregas de forma orientada a resultados , equilibrando velocidade e qualidade; medir o impacto das suas entregas por meio de métricas claras (retenção, conversão, satisfação).
  • Assumir a liderança técnica de projetos de alto impacto , propondo soluções criativas, resilientes e escaláveis no longo prazo.
  • Trabalhar de ponta a ponta: do desenho de protótipos à instrumentação em produção, passando por testes automatizados e ajustes rápidos próprios de um ambiente ágil.

O que buscamos

  • Mentalidade de Produto : você pensa além do “faça funcionar” e questiona “isso resolve o problema certo?”.
  • Foco em Resultados : orienta suas decisões por métricas de negócio e pelo sucesso do usuário, não apenas por linhas de código entregues.
  • Comunicação Clara : sabe alinhar visões técnicas e de produto, facilitando discussões e tomando decisões conjuntas com outras áreas.
  • Versatilidade em Tecnologia : tem experiência sólida em alguma stack moderna, e sem apego a ferramentas ou linguagens específicas.
  • Autonomia e Protagonismo : assume responsabilidades, conduz experimentos A/B, itera rápido e aprende com os resultados, sem depender de micro-gestão.
  • Curiosidade e Evolução Contínua : busca novas tecnologias, melhores práticas e tendências de mercado, elevando o patamar técnico e de produto do nosso ecossistema.

Por que vir para a Zippi?

  • Uma causa pela qual vale a pena lutar : nossa missão é ajudar micro e pequenas empresas a prosperar. Seu trabalho impactará diretamente 22 milhões de empreendedores brasileiros, ampliando o acesso financeiro em um mercado enorme e carente de soluções.
  • Ownership e construção desde o primeiro dia : como um early team member, você terá papel essencial na criação da área de crescimento de uma startup lucrativa, bem financiada e apoiada pela YCombinator.
  • Aprendizado acelerado com gente boa : aqui você terá a oportunidade de se envolver em projetos estratégicos e enfrentar desafios complexos ao lado de fundadores e operadores de fintechs de ponta. Nossos times são colaborativos, atuam com autonomia e carregam um alto grau de responsabilidade.

O que você pode esperar da gente!

  • Remuneração na faixa alta de mercado;
  • Participação em nosso programa de Stock Options;
  • Learning Budget anual;
  • Plano de Saúde 100% pago pela Zippi para você e para dependentes até 18 anos. Para cônjuges e companheiros (as), cobrimos 50% da mensalidade;
  • Auxílio-creche para crianças até 6 anos;

title: Mobile Engineer (Remote)
description:
The world of digital assets is accelerating in speed, magnitude, and complexity, opening the door to new ways for leveraging the blockchain. Fireblocks’ platform and network provide the simplest and most secure way for companies to work with digital assets and it trusted by some of the largest financial institutions, banks, globally-recognized brands, and Web3 companies in the world, including BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Revolut, and thousands more.

As part of Fireblocks, Dynamic represents the next evolution of non-custodial wallet infrastructure. Dynamic is Fireblocks’ embedded wallet platform, purpose-built for developers who want to bring crypto and stablecoin experiences into modern applications without complexity. Together, Fireblocks and Dynamic are building the most complete, secure, and developer-friendly wallet infrastructure in the industry by combining institutional-grade security with consumer-grade experiences.

About the Team

Dynamic was founded in 2021 with a simple vision: every app and website will have a wallet component. That vision is rapidly becoming reality. Wallets are no longer limited to crypto-native products, they are becoming foundational infrastructure for payroll, remittances, and global payments. Dynamic powers wallet-based experiences for leading crypto and fintech teams including Kraken, zerohash, Magic Eden, and more.

Dynamic builds and maintains developer-first SDKs that enable teams to seamlessly integrate embedded wallet functionality directly into their applications. These embedded wallets allow end users to create, manage, and use wallets without leaving the product experience, making wallets feel like a native part of modern fintech and crypto apps.

As part of Fireblocks, the Dynamic team continues to build and scale the infrastructure and developer tooling that has onboarded 50M+ wallets across crypto and fintech applications. In this context, Dynamic powers the application-layer wallet experience and developer tooling, complementing Fireblocks’ core custody, security, and transaction infrastructure. The team operates with a strong product mindset and deep focus on security, reliability, scalability, and exceptional developer experience. Engineers at Dynamic build secure‑by‑default systems and approach their work with a strong customer focus, balancing technical excellence with real-world user needs. You will be joining a passionate group that moves fast, works with the biggest names in payments and fintech, and is defining how the next generation of financial applications are built.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and implement high-quality native mobile SDKs that enable developers to integrate embedded wallet functionality into their applications, with a strong focus on API ergonomics, performance, and reliability.
  • Own SDK features end-to-end: from API design and architecture, through implementation and testing, to release, versioning, and developer documentation.
  • Build and maintain secure, reliable SDK components for wallet operations, including cryptographic operations, blockchain interactions, and security-sensitive flows.
  • Define and evolve the SDK architecture to support long-term maintainability, backward compatibility, and adoption across diverse customer applications.
  • Build sample applications and demos that showcase SDK capabilities and serve as integration references for customers.
  • Create clear, comprehensive SDK documentation and integration guides.
  • Work with developer relations and support teams to address customer integration challenges.
  • Raise the bar for quality and operational excellence by establishing best practices around testing, observability, releases, and code health.
  • Contribute to a culture of ownership and execution, leading by example through hands‑on work, code reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with deep focus on mobile development and shipping production‑grade SDKs.
  • Demonstrated track record of building and shipping high‑quality code, with work you can point to and discuss in depth.
  • Strong hands‑on experience with iOS (Swift) and/or Android (Kotlin); experience with React Native or other cross‑platform frameworks, and familiarity with all.
  • Experience building mobile SDKs or shared libraries, including API design, versioning, packaging, and long‑term maintenance across platforms.
  • Experience with blockchain‑enabled mobile systems, including wallet flows, signing, and on‑chain interactions.
  • Experience working on security‑sensitive mobile software, such as key management, secure storage, cryptography, or financial products.
  • Strong grasp of mobile engineering best practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, release management, and observability.
  • A get‑things‑done mindset with the ability to independently own problems and deliver end‑to‑end solutions.
  • Comfortable making long‑term architectural decisions while remaining pragmatic and adaptable.
  • B.Sc. in Computer Science / Engineering or equivalent practical experience.
  • Remote role in a distributed team; preference for candidates in the Americas time zone.

Big Advantages

  • Rust and/or WebAssembly (Wasm) experience, particularly building cross‑platform SDKs consumed by mobile apps.
  • Experience designing shared core logic used across iOS and Android.
  • Experience with advanced mobile security primitives (secure hardware, MPC, low‑level crypto).
  • Prior experience owning or founding a mobile platform or SDK from scratch.

Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms.

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters — to you, to your community, and to the world.

Progress starts with you.

Job Description

We are seeking a Manager of Sales Engineering with comprehensive and demonstrated technical expertise in a digital financial services setting. This role focuses on our Visa Digital Enablement Solutions and involves a wide range of responsibilities including client‑specific solutioning and open‑box discussions, leading technical discussions and demonstrations. This role will provide detailed technical integration options to prospective and existing clients. The ideal candidate will be a proven strategic thinker with a solid technical understanding of digital banking API/SDK based products, emerging market trends, and payment/issuer processing. The Manager of Sales Engineering will be instrumental in achieving client and revenue targets for Visa DES solutions and must be capable of explaining technical solutions to technical and non‑technical audiences.

The successful candidate is expected to have a deep understanding of the issuing payments ecosystem, capable of collaborating and influencing across a diverse range of internal and external stakeholders and work alongside sales specialist/generalist to accelerate sales in Brazil.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver expert technical guidance to prospects to help them understand how to create compelling digital experiences using Visa Digital Enablement products and services.
  • Explain technical solutions and consult with prospects to present white label, API, and SDK digital banking integration options across multiple digital channels.
  • Support on‑site and virtual sales pitches and client renewals through presentations and demonstrations.
  • Communicate technical requirements and dependencies, pre‑requisites, configuration options, implementation considerations and develop end to end technical flows in partnership with clients.
  • Maintain a deep knowledge of all DES, Visa, and processor related products and services.
  • Maintain deep understanding of DES development roadmap and influence roadmap priorities by communicating client needs to product teams.
  • Deliver product and competitor information to drive and support product development and innovation strategies.
  • Identify and highlight key partnership opportunities across the digital banking industry e.g. (Mobile/online banking providers, processors, etc.)
  • Collaborate with product teams to ensure generalist/specialized sales teams are well educated and up to date on DES products and services.
  • Craft persuasive, technically accurate RFP responses and solution proposals for banks and fintechs.
  • Foster in‑depth and productive relationships at all levels with the client and the Visa organization.
  • Actively lead various ad‑hoc internal projects as assigned.
  • Translate client requirements into clear implementation deliverables (Solution Designs), ensuring readiness before project kickoff.
  • Engage with internal cross functional teams including Product Management, Product Development, Client Support and Product Marketing to relay market feedback and provide input into the design of innovative solutions.

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5 years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or at least 3 years of work experience with an advanced degree (e.g., Masters/MBA/JD/MD)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5-8 years or more of work experience with a bachelor’s degree
  • Experience with technical sales, product and management experience in the mobile/online banking and payments industry.
  • Proven history of successful sales and/or relationship management.
  • Ability to manage & grow internal and external resources and cross functional relationships.
  • Ability to work independently and in collaboration with high level of success/achievement.
  • Ability to travel as needed to ensure adequate on‑site interaction with the client.
  • Exceptional customer service and advocacy experience and mindset.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Ability to work across multiple time zones.
  • Spanish is desirable.

Unique Knowledge and Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of mobile/online banking and issuer processing environments including digital issuance and tokenization.
  • Strong knowledge of API/SDK and mobile/online technologies (iOS, Android, Web, etc.) and non‑native mobile app development technologies (React Native, Cordova, etc.).
  • Strong knowledge of modern banking platforms (core systems, issuer processors, networks) and functionality.
  • Superior presentation skills with technical sales acumen.
  • Excellent client engagement and relationship building skills.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to establish effective relationships across all levels of management.
  • Keen interest in innovation and technology.
  • Exceptional ability to manage & foster internal and external resources and cross‑functional relationships.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and operating in an environment synonymous with change.
  • Ability through written and verbal communication to articulate complex, technical information adaptable to technical and non‑technical audiences.

Additional Information

Sobre o PicPay

A companhia atua em diversas frentes, como Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Física, Serviços Financeiros para Pessoa Jurídica, Investimentos e PicPay Shop. Pautados pela nossa cultura, seguimos no propósito de dar muito mais pique para a vida de milhões de brasileiros. Conheça nossos valores: Atitude de Dono(a), Disciplina, Determinação, Disponibilidade, Simplicidade, Humildade e Franqueza.

O respeito, a ética, a busca pela equidade e a valorização da pluralidade são elementos inegociáveis e fazem parte da prática no nosso dia a dia aqui no PicPay. Por isso, esta vaga está aberta para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, religião, etnia, deficiência, idade, orientação sexual ou qualquer outro fator.

Sobre a Vaga

O Tech Manager é a ponte que une o produto com a parte técnica visando a entrega e acompanhamento dos projetos, provendo a robustez necessária para que tenhamos escalabilidade, estabilidade e segurança para suportar milhares de clientes navegando em nossas plataformas. Também é uma de suas missões, dimensionar tamanho e necessidades da equipe, identificando e removendo os impedimentos que não estão ao alcance do próprio time resolver, garantindo visibilidade para dentro e para fora do Squad. Além disso, é a pessoa que faz a gestão do dia a dia dos desenvolvedores da Squad que atua sendo referência para assuntos como: banco de horas, férias, engajamento e clima, dúvidas do dia a dia e feedbacks situacionais, essas decisões devem ser baseadas em dados e métricas tiradas do time e das pessoas.

title: Gestor de Incidentes
description:
QUEM SOMOS:

Você é um apaixonado por negócios e Tecnologia e está em busca de novos desafios?Então, a BMP é o seu lugar ! Estamos crescendo cada dia mais e buscando pessoas com espírito de liderança, criativas e atentas à inovação para fazer parte do nosso time. Se você está pronto para fazer parte de um ambiente dinâmico e colaborativo e quer transformar o mercado financeiro, confira os requisitos para a vaga de Product Owner.

Sobre a BMP

Somos um Hub de novos modelos de negócios que constrói produtos financeiros e bancários aliados à inovação. Nossas soluções proprietárias e de alta infraestrutura tecnológica atendem a necessidade de cada parceiro de maneira simples, eficiente e segura.

Nossa marca está no centro da revolução financeira, afinal, somos referência em Credit as a Service e o BAAS (Banking As a Service) número 1 do Brasil , com o propósito de transformar o mercado financeiro e construir, junto com os nossos parceiros, o Banco do Futuro.

Principais atividades (Tarefas e atribuições):

Coordenação do Processo de Gestão de Incidentes

  • Assegurar que todos os incidentes sejam identificados, classificados, priorizados e tratados conforme a política
  • Receber notificações, avaliar informações iniciais e direcionar as ações às equipes competentes (TI, NOC, SOC, segurança, negócio).
  • Garantir o cumprimento das etapas formais: notificação, classificação (incluindo NISI), planejamento de ação, execução, registro (RISI) e encerramento.

Comunicação Corporativa de Incidentes

  • Definir e operar um plano de comunicação claro , adequado à severidade:
    • Comunicação simples para incidentes de baixa criticidade;
    • Comunicação estruturada para incidentes médios e altos;
    • Comunicação imediata para Diretoria, Jurídico, áreas de negócio e parceiros críticos nos incidentes graves.
  • Garantir consistência e precisão nas informações compartilhadas.

Integração com Mudanças e Problemas (ITIL/COBIT)

  • Coordenar identificação de mudanças necessárias decorrentes de incidentes críticos ou recorrentes.
  • Apoiar abertura de problemas , especialmente quando houver causa raiz não compreendida ou reincidência.
  • Integrar os três ciclos (Incidentes–Problemas–Mudanças) para:
    • Prevenir reincidências;
    • Garantir implementações em janelas seguras (finais de semana/horários restritos);
    • Incorporar aprendizados no catálogo de mudanças e melhorias.

Governança e Post Mortem

  • Conduzir ou coordenar análises pós-incidente (post mortem) para incidentes de criticidade alta.
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos consolidando causas, impacto, falhas de processo, gaps de controles e recomendações.
  • Propor ações preventivas e corretivas ao Comitê de Segurança e às diretorias.

Atividades‑Chave da Posição

  1. Centralizar a gestão de incidentes em um único ponto de coordenação.
  2. Garantir que incidentes sejam tratados dentro dos SLAs definidos , com escalonamento adequado.
  3. Manter rotinas regulares com NOC/SOC para correlação, investigação e priorização de eventos.
  4. Construir dashboards executivos (status, tendências, tempos de resposta, severidade, reincidência).
  5. Estabelecer critérios claros de severidade , fundamentados em impacto ao negócio, clientes e requisitos regulatórios.
  6. Gerenciar incidentes de segurança , respeitando procedimentos de cadeia de custódia, privacidade e sigilo.
  7. Acionar comitês e lideranças conforme classificação e natureza do incidente .

Do que você precisa (Requisitos e Qualificações):

  • Domínio de práticas ITIL (principalmente Incident, Problem e Change Management).
  • Conhecimento das políticas de segurança da informação e continuidade de negócios.
  • Capacidade de analisar logs, eventos, evidências e correlações de NOC/SOC.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de SIEM, gestão de incidentes, monitoramento e governança.

Informações adicionais:

  • Modelo 100% presencial, na Av Paulista;
  • Jornada de 2ª a 6ª - das 9h às 18h.

O que oferecemos:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado;
  • VR Flex no valor de R$45,00;
  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;
  • Propay - Programa de Saúde e Bem-estar;
  • Convênio com a FIAP (descontos para cursos de graduação, Pós e MBA em tecnologia);
  • Escola BMP (cursos gratuitos nas áreas de comunicação, financeira, tecnologia e outras);
  • Programa Construindo o Futuro;
  • Gratificações anuais.

The role of Engagement Manager involves managing and delivering innovative solutions using the OutSystems platform through an agile approach. This position will coordinate with various differentbusiness and work with the development team to provide a solution that meets the client’s needs.

As an Engagement Manager, your responsibilities include:

  • Orchestrating the successful delivery of complex projects while fostering strong client relationships.

  • This role involves planning activities and team allocation, estimating task effort, managing schedules, budget control, risk management, requirements gathering, workflow design, mapping and drafting user stories, conducting functional tests, leading grooming meetings, demonstrations, and status updates.

Technical knowledge

  • Lead the project and be responsible for 'makingit happen', negotiating, maintaining a sense of urgency, managing risks and maintaining good communication with everyone involved.

  • Be the representative of the team in the deliveries of the releases.
  • Focus on what can add the most value to the project so that maximum satisfaction occurs for clients and users.
  • Manage changes, ensuring understanding of business impacts and keeping everyone informed about the agreed-upon delivery plan with the client and the Delivery Manager / Tech Lead.
  • Identify stakeholders, promoters and detractors, understand their motivations and what they expect from the project.
  • Ensure the correct use of the methodology by all project participants, generating understanding and giving visibility of the results.
  • Define the project vision, ultimate goal, key motivators, write the profiles of all personas, update the workflow, and map the user story.
  • Lead and conduct requirements gathering, business analysis, and definition of the customer experience, thus understanding the entire product/project, business processes, and users that the application will support.
  • Ensure and validate DoR and DoD concepts for all product requirements.
  • Communicate the vision and business requirements to the delivery/development team and serve as the business representative for them.
  • Manage the backlog, write user stories, conduct preparation sessions and requirement definitions, schedule and lead scrum meetings, demonstrations, sprint planning, and retrospective meetings, prepare the status report, perform testing, prepare the project handover, and oversee all other ceremonies and deliveries for projects in the agile methodology.

  • Project and/or Software Product Management using the OutSystems platform.
  • Project and/or Software Product Management using Low-code technology.
  • Managing client relationships from the beginning to the end throughout the entire project.
  • Advanced English (spoken and written)

Nice to have

About InPlanet

REMOTE WITHIN BRAZIL (ideally SP)

Fluency in English and Portuguese both written and oral

We are an impact-driven, remote-first, ClimateTech (CDR) startup headquartered in Germany and Brazil to reverse climate change and make tropical agriculture more regenerative, low-carbon, and sustainable. We are working with Enhanced Rock Weathering in tropical agriculture, focusing on Brazil. We do this to create a liveable planet for future generations and, specifically, to regenerate soils and ecosystems, grow nutritious food, and increase food security and sovereignty in the tropics.

People-first, Performance Culture: We believe that focus on people and performance can co-exist with the right cultural vision. Our philosophy is to blend these two essential components. The Rocket symbolizes our commitment to peak performance, excellence, and reaching new heights. The Heart represents our dedication to our people, fostering empathy, compassion, and genuine care for every team member's well-being.

We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We are proud to have an internationally growing team and we are designing our people practices to serve psychological safety, belonging, and authenticity.

You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us.

Check out our Culture page here

About the Role

As our Senior Research and Development (R+D) Manager you will lead and be responsible for managing our research and development programme relating to deployment of Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) as a carbon dioxide removal technique in Brazil, with a special focus on agronomic trials. You will design, manage and interpret data from experiments in order to effectively monitor agronomic parameters and as well as addressing fundamental research questions relating to ERW. You will be based in Brazil, with presence onsite at various locations within Brazil when necessary.

The Impact you can make

This role will oversee and manage team members and you will take ownership over experiments, driving forward our scientific strategy. You lead on our reporting on farmer co-benefits and impact metrics, providing robust scientific evidence to support the case for our wider impact. You will play a key role in managing and driving our science strategy and will be expected to maintain and develop relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

Core working relationships

Reporting to the Head of Science and Research (Christina), you will support and work effectively with all members of the science and operations teams. You will manage and work closely with our Science and Impact Lead (Phil).

Key Responsibilities

  • Management of team members within our R+D programme
  • Overseeing and planing our R+D programme such as design of experiments and communication with external stakeholders
  • Generating, analysing, presenting and publishing data from experiments and deployments to wide-ranging and high-profile audiences
  • You will support operations to provide the robust scientific evidence for our farmer pitches and case studies
  • You drive research and the wider science team strategy
  • You manage communications and partnerships with leading researchers globally, with a specific focus on Brazil
  • You will work flexibility in Brazil, with travel to onsite experiments within Brazil and to visit partners (expectation & benefit)

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • You are an experienced senior scientist with a PhD (or equivalent experience) in Soil Science, Agronomy, Earth Science, Geochemistry, Biogeochemistry or related fields
  • You have, ideally, 5+ years experience in senior research or research related roles
  • You have extensive experience in research and development and experimental design, ideally with a focus on agronomy or a related field
  • You have a proven track record of previously successful research projects and publications in high quality journals
  • You have worked on successful research projects with a wide range of stakeholders and partners, e.g. from industry, government and academia.
  • You have knowledge of geology, geochemistry and weathering processes
  • You have knowledge of agronomy and agronomic trials
  • You are fluent in Portuguese
  • You have advanced English language skills
  • You are based in Brazil

Key Qualities

  • You are a thought-leader and able to breakdown complex topics and present them in a clear and concise way
  • You are independent, confident, hands-on, a go-getter, full of energy and possess an exceptional drive
  • You are a fast learner and want to steadily improve your professional and personal skill set
  • You are a team player, willing to work with and support others in the team where necessary including actively volunteering for tasks to assist where appropriate

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Industry (CDR) and management experience is a real plus
  • You are **based near Piracicaba (SP) or happy to relocate
  • Experience with OKR goal setting

What You Can Expect:

Tax Compliance and Tax Accounting:

  • Lead the accurate and timely completion of all monthly and annual tax and informational filings to ensure compliance with Federal, State, and Municipal tax laws (covering direct and indirect taxes)
  • Ensure that the tax books and accounting tax records are correctly and timely recorded and aligned with Brown-Forman accounting guidelines, CPC (Brazilian Accounting Pronouncements Committee), and IFRS (International Financial Reporting Standards)
  • Review and approve the U.S. GAAP and statutory calculations for taxable income, current tax, and deferred tax, as well as the annual tax true‑up adjustment
  • Coordinate and supervise the submission of the various tax reporting files to Corporate Tax (quarter and annual), including quarterly forecasts of U.S. GAAP income before taxes and tax expense
  • Ensure tax obligations are submitted in the Government system:
    • SPED Tax and Accounting
    • SPED Contributions
  • Update billing and tax accounting systems (SAP and BFSO) in accordance to changes in legislation of PIS, COFINS, Excise Tax, Importation Tax, Income Tax and protocols related to ICMS‑ST
  • Control withholding tax on services to third parties (IR, ISS, INSS, PCC)
  • Perform/review monthly accounting reconciliations of taxes (PIS/COFINS/Excise Tax/ICMS/ICMS‑ST) of goods, fixed assets, material promotion, etc

Brazilian Tax Reform and Strategic Tax Management:

  • Lead the Company’s response to the Brazilian Tax Reform
  • Analyze draft legislation and proposed changes to assess the impact on Brown‑Forman Brazil’s tax burden, systems, and compliance processes
  • Develop and execute transition plans for adapting billing, tax determination, and accounting systems (SAP) to comply with new legislation
  • Oversee the process for securing the data requested by transfer pricing consultants to meet Brazil transfer pricing documentation requirements; review the draft reports prepared by the consultants and provide comments to ensure reports are completed timely and efficiently
  • Review intercompany transactions, including relevant transfer pricing strategies and necessary documentation

  • Follow up on open tax credits and proactively implement strategies to recover/compensate promptly
  • Lead, develop and motivate team members to reach personal, department and Company goals
  • Actively participate in different forums within the industry, such as the Brazilian Beverages Association (Abrabe & ABBD), to understand potential tax reforms and the impacts on BFB´s tax obligations and proactively defend the company´s interests
  • Develop and maintain a professional network of peers within the BFB office
  • Maintain a network with consultants and regulating bodies to ensure BFB is updated on changes in laws and regulations
  • Participate/lead projects as required

What You Bring to the Table:

  • Bachelor of Accounting Sciences, Administration, Economy or Similar
  • 7+ years in similar positions
  • High‑level experience in Brazilian tax legislation and technical tax requirements
  • Proficient in English (oral and written)
  • Experience in SAP or a similar ERP
  • Proficient in Excel and/or Google Sheets
  • Experience as a people manager, training and developing teams
  • Experience in multi‑national organizations with a broad global presence

What Makes You Unique:

  • Initiative and forward‑thinking
  • Ability to work collaboratively with other areas of the organization and external partners
  • Negotiation and decision‑making skills
  • Strategic thinking
  • Time and resource management
  • Communication and storytelling skills
  • Proven desire to improve processes and adapt to an ever‑changing, and sometimes ambiguous environment

We help growers increase yields, protect their crops, and tackle today’s challenges through science‑driven and sustainable innovations. Our portfolio includes trusted crop protection products, nutrient management tools, and advanced delivery systems.

We serve a wide variety of crops — from corn and soybeans to vegetables and specialty crops — and are deeply committed to environmental stewardship, sustainable practices, and meaningful partnerships. At American Vanguard , we are advancing agriculture through innovation, sustainability, and real‑world results.

About the Position:

The Brazil Director is responsible for leading all related aspects needed for the success of Amvac Brazil. Its position has to create the commercial strategy capable to capture the opportunity of the Crop Protection and Green Solution market and create value for all of our stakeholders. The Director must lead with passion and promote a culture aligned with company values.

Commercial, Sales and Business Management

  • Representation of the company with Associations, Government Authorities, etc.
  • Keep informed Regional HQ about relevant changes in the market, prices, competitor strategies, etc.

Leadership, People Management and Organizational Development

  • Must recruit and manage staff, including performance monitoring, and mentoring, coaching, training and developing talent.
  • Maintain a motivated, highly skilled and passionate team.
  • Be active part and lead interdepartmental committees like Credit Committee, Local SIOP, Product/Portfolio Committee.

Skills, Knowledge, and Ability Requirements:

  • Excellent business acumen, critical decision‑making abilities, and strategic thinker who can effectively manage details.
  • Willing to work closely with Sales and Product Development Teams directly on the ground.
  • Technical knowledge of main crops like Soybean, cotton, corn.
  • Strong sales, operational and supply chain understanding.
  • Superior skills and comprehension of financial and forecasting elements.
  • Strong commitment to achieving sales and profit results, showing a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding targeted objectives.
  • Proficient commercial management Skills, able to organize and lead sales teams, to attract potential customers, and create new commercial opportunities for the company.
  • Ability to build cross functional relationships, gaining alignment from peers, leaders, customers and other stakeholders in the organization to drive commercial strategic goals.
  • Capable of handling and leading commercial relationships with main customers.
  • Performs role of a leader by motivating and inspiring others to perform well, while displaying self‑confidence, passion and optimism regarding the business.
  • Ability to lead a team to achieve results in a challenging market.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills creating collaborative relationships.
  • Promote a competitive environment throughout the Sales Team. Create and follow up KPI’s by sales rep, by region, by crop.
  • Technologically savvy; ability to quickly learn and utilize multiple enterprise systems.
  • Able to work independently (with little supervision) as well as part of a team.
  • Honesty, integrity, perseverance, creativity and passion.

The ideal candidate will be based in, or preferably reside in São Paulo, Ribeirão Preto, or Campinas , to ensure close connection with key customers, teams, and business operations across the region.

Academic Background and Experience

  • A degree in Agriculture or related field (This is a Must). MBA or business related degree is a plus.
  • Minimum 7–10 years of experience in the agrochemical market in positions related to Sales Management, Commercial Management, or General Management. (This is a Must)
  • Ability to communicate in Spanish and English.
  • Comprehensive knowledge and understanding of the Brazilian Agriculture industry, regulations, crops, market and agro chemical commercial channels. (required)
  • Possess subject matter expertise (technical) and credibility necessary to support the Sales team.

Job Description

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Position Overview

Boeing Brazil is seeking a Senior Electrical Cabin Systems Engineer , reporting to the Electrical and Electronics Engineering Manager, working out of the São José Dos Campos office.

The Senior Electrical Cabin Systems Engineer will join the team to defining and integrating airplane electrical systems across our commercial fleet.

This position will be assigned to work with Cabin Systems Team which includes In Flight Entertainment, Cabin Services System, Cameras & Sensors, interior lighting, passenger address systems, seat back video and more.

All projects center on the translation of concepts and high-level requirements to specific architectures and operational specifications including the physical integration of electrical systems and components into our complex airplanes. Work with a worldwide supplier base to implement system hardware and software. Validate designs through both laboratory and airplane testing. Work with aircraft systems from initial concept through certification, delivery, and through their production life. We are continually evolving the state of the art in commercial air transport.

Position Responsibilities

  • Works with customers to develop and document complex electronic and electrical system requirements.
  • Analyzes and translates requirements into system, hardware and software designs and interface specifications.
  • Tests and validates to ensure system designs meet operational and functional requirements.
  • Monitors supplier performance to ensure system integration and compliance with requirements.
  • Solves problems concerning and provides other support of fielded hardware and software over the entire product lifecycle.
  • Research and interpret engineering data including drawing specs, CATIA/CAD models, installation plans and various maintenance procedures to develop systems requirements.
  • Researches specific technology advances for potential application to company business needs.

Work Arrangement

This position is hybrid/telecommuting. The selected candidate will be required to perform work onsite at one of the listed location options. This is at the hiring team’s discretion and could potentially change in the future.

Employer will not sponsor applicants for employment visa status.

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills / Experience)

  • Must have existing rights to work in Brazil.
  • Must have a Bachelor Degree in Engineering.
  • Proficient in both verbal and written communications skills in the English Language.
  • Must be registered or eligible to register with the Engineering and Agronomy Regional Council (Conselho Regional de Engenharia e Agronomia - CREA). Applicable to Brazilian, recent engineering graduates within 6 months and foreign engineers when the employer is willing visa sponsor.
  • Experience working in a professional environment.

Preferred Qualifications (Education/Experience)

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or computer Engineering.
  • Relevant experience within Electrical Systems hardware and software design.
  • In depth experience with system design and integration during an airplane development program.
  • In depth experience with equipment design, specification and tests, ensuring compliance with industry standards (e.g. RTCA DO-160).
  • In depth experience in Electrical design; including but not limited to Electrical Systems design, Wire Design, Electrical Equipment Installation and Wire Installation Design.
  • Experience with project management skills within a fast paced highly integrated environment.
  • Experience working with cross functional teams.
  • Experience within requirement verification and validation, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements (e.g., V-model application on ARP-4754).
  • Experience with equipment and systems certification under regulatory authorities (e.g. FAA, EASA).

Relocation

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.

Additional Information

This requisition is for a locally hired position in Brazil. Candidates must have current legal authorization to live and work in Brazil. Benefits and pay are determined at the local level and are not part of Boeing U.S. based payroll.

Please also submit a CV or resume written in English.

Applications for this position will be accepted until Feb. 07, 2026 .

This is not an Export Control position.

Missão do cargo

Responsável pela execução das estratégias (Fotografia de Sucesso) definidas para o canal e região nas suas lojas de atuação, supervisionando e desenvolvendo a equipe de promotores sob sua gestão, garantindo um bom relacionamento e atendimento com todos os stakeholders das lojas, de modo a maximizar os negócios de seus clientes e consequentemente da HEINEKEN Brasil.

Superior completo ou cursando (sendo 70% do curso já concluído).

Nossa missão é impactar 1 bilhão de pessoas com as nossas soluções de assinatura. Para isso, tomamos decisões rápidas, com ousadia e sempre com foco em melhorar a vida dos nossos clientes.

Aqui, cada conquista tem um nome: pessoas reais que fazem acontecer. Buscamos pessoas com quem possamos contar, apoiar no crescimento e ter orgulho de chamar de ranger. Procuramos pessoas analíticas, honestas e que tragam leveza para a jornada — porque aqui, a diversão também faz parte do caminho.

Quer fazer parte de algo realmente grande e aprender MUITO ao lado das pessoas mais determinadas e apaixonadas pelo que fazem? Então #vemserallu!

O que você fará no dia a dia ?

  1. Acompanhar a rotina operacional da equipe de SDRs, garantindo execução dos processos de prospecção e qualificação;
  2. Monitorar KPIs individuais e coletivos, assegurando a performance e a disciplina nos rituais da área;
  3. Realizar feedbacks contínuos, one a ones e apoiar no desenvolvimento individual dos membros do time;
  4. Apoiar o onboarding e treinamentos dos novos SDRs, garantindo rápida integração e curva de aprendizado;
  5. Reportar resultados e status de atividades ao Coordenador, contribuindo com insights sobre oportunidades de melhoria;
  6. Sugerir ajustes em processos, roteiros de abordagem e playbooks para aumentar a eficiência do time.

O que esperamos de você ?

Buscamos alguém com experiência em liderança de times de SDRs, próximo à operação, com foco em acompanhamento, motivação e desenvolvimento da equipe. É essencial ter organização, disciplina, empatia e boa comunicação para guiar o time no dia a dia, além de olhar analítico para identificar oportunidades de melhoria e agir rapidamente.

  1. Tenha disciplina e organização para acompanhar rotinas e métricas diárias (quantidade de ligações, cadências, conversão de leads, follow-ups);
  2. Seja capaz de identificar rapidamente gargalos na operação e orientar ajustes junto ao time;
  3. Conduza feedbacks objetivos e construtivos , apoiando o desenvolvimento contínuo dos SDRs;

  5. Tenha habilidade de treinar e reciclar técnicas de abordagem constantemente, mantendo o time atualizado em frameworks e boas práticas de vendas;
  6. Ajude a criar um ambiente de alta energia, colaboração e foco em resultados , mantendo o time engajado;
  7. Tenha postura de dono da operação , garantindo que as metas de qualificação de leads e agendamento de oportunidades sejam alcançadas;
  8. Traga olhar analítico para interpretar relatórios de performance, identificar tendências e apresentar melhorias ao Coordenador;
  9. Consiga gerenciar prioridades em tempo real , equilibrando cobrança por resultados com o desenvolvimento das pessoas.

Por isso precisamos que você possua:

  1. Experiência prévia em liderança ou supervisão de times de SDRs;
  2. Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Administração, Economia, Engenharia ou áreas relacionadas a negócios;

  4. Certificações em vendas consultivas ou metodologias de prospecção.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Research Fellow-3 role at Inside Higher Ed .

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

$45,000-$55,000

description:
Supervisor de Captação de Recursos (Joinville PF e PJ)

O Pequeno Cotolengo Joinvilense é uma Organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, dedicada ao cuidado especializado, à inclusão e à promoção da dignidade de crianças, jovens e adultos com Transtorno do Espectro Autista (TEA), deficiência intelectual e necessidades de reabilitação. Inspirado pelo carisma de São Luís Orione, o trabalho da instituição une ciência, fé e inovação em saúde, garantindo um atendimento humanizado e de excelência àqueles que mais precisam. Vinculada à Congregação da Pequena Obra da Divina Providência – São Luís Orione, presente em 34 países, a organização atua com base em valores de solidariedade, amor e dedicação aos mais vulneráveis. A unidade de Joinville conta com mais de 100 mil m² de área total e 700 m² de estrutura construída, composta por consultórios, salas de reabilitação, brinquedoteca temática da Peanuts, espaços sensoriais e já preparada para futuros atendimentos em equoterapia. O cuidado é realizado por uma equipe interdisciplinar altamente qualificada, que aplica protocolos reconhecidos internacionalmente, como ABA, Pediasuit e Bobath. Todo esse trabalho é sustentado por parceiros e doadores que confiam na causa. Cada recurso é aplicado com transparência, responsabilidade e foco em gerar impacto real na vida dos pacientes.

Sobre o Complexo de Saúde Pequeno Cotolengo:

O Pequeno Cotolengo Joinvilense é a primeira filial do Complexo de Saúde Pequeno Cotolengo, sediado em Curitiba há mais de 60 anos. A matriz é acreditada internacionalmente pela Joint Commission International (JCI), reconhecida entre as 100 Melhores ONGs do Brasil, eleita a Melhor ONG do Paraná e certificada como um dos Melhores Lugares para Trabalhar pelo GPTW. Essa trajetória de excelência, governança e credibilidade reforça a missão do Pequeno Cotolengo: cuidar das pessoas e transformar vidas.

ATRIBUIÇÕES DO CARGO

  • Supervisionar a equipe sob sua responsabilidade, oferecendo suporte técnico e comportamental, garantindo engajamento e alinhamento à cultura organizacional.
  • Propor, informar e acompanhar metas individuais e coletivas.
  • Selecionar, treinar, avaliar desempenho e orientar o desenvolvimento dos membros da equipe.

Olá, somos o Sírio-Libanês!

Somos uma instituição de saúde centenária, que através da sua atuação em mais de 60 especialidades, tem como propósito levar vida plena e digna a um número cada vez maior de pessoas. A cada ano, contribuímos para a formação de profissionais da saúde e atendemos milhares de pacientes.

Queremos você para fazer parte dessa história!

Nesta posição você será responsável por:

  • Atender ao colaborador com abordagem centrada na pessoa visando a prevenção de riscos ocupacionais, a avaliação da capacidade laborativa, promoção em saúde e realizando os direcionamentos necessários;

  • Recomendar afastamento do trabalho, fornecendo atestados e pareceres sempre que indicado considerando que o repouso ou o afastamento de determinados agentes agressivos faz parte do tratamento;
  • Avaliar de forma imparcial atestados de afastamento ao trabalho emitido por terceiros, zelando pelo adequado equilíbrio nas relações saúde e trabalho;
  • Atuar visando essencialmente à promoção da saúde e à prevenção de doenças e acidentes de trabalho, sem, contudo, deixar de atender demandas de saúde emergenciais dos colaboradores e, principalmente, os acidentados do trabalho, fornecendo laudos, pareceres e relatórios de exame médico e dando os devidos encaminhamentos para especialidades necessárias ou instituições de saúde, para benefício do paciente e dentro dos preceitos éticos reconhecidos;
  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, bem como ampliar sua própria competência quanto conhecimento sobre riscos ocupacionais e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes;
  • Participar de reuniões periódicas com o time de saúde compartilhando conhecimentos e experiências no sentido da redução de acidentes de trabalho, prevenção de doença e promoção de saúde;
  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, Código Internacional de Ética para Profissionais de Medicina do Trabalho bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

Para este desafio você precisará ter:

  • Residência e/ou Pós-graduação em Medicina do Trabalho concluído;
  • Interface com atenção primária, secundária e terciária;
  • Conhecimentos em atenção primária à saúde e coordenação do cuidado em saúde suplementar pública ou privada;
  • Experiência em situações Agudas de Saúde e Urgência e Emergência;
  • Curso de suporte à vida (ACLS);
  • Título de Especialista em Medicina do Trabalho com RQE

O que buscamos?

Um profissional que consiga ser um gestor de projetos eficaz, garantindo que a obra:

  • Seja segura e legal.
  • Seja concluída dentro do orçamento e do prazo.
  • Minimize o transtorno causado pela obra.

As principais funções do síndico no contexto de obras são:

  • Garantir a Segurança e a Conformidade Legal
    Exigir o cumprimento da NBR 16.280 e do regimento interno do condomínio em todas as reformas, seja nas áreas comuns ou nas unidades privativas.
    Zelar pela conservação e segurança da edificação (Art. 1.348, V, do Código Civil), responsabilizando‑se por qualquer dano causado por negligência na fiscalização.
  • Autorizações e Documentação
    Analisar e aprovar o Plano de Reforma detalhado antes de qualquer obra ser iniciada.
    Exigir a Anotação de Responsabilidade Técnica (ART) ou o Registro de Responsabilidade Técnica (RRT), assinados por engenheiro ou arquiteto habilitado, garantindo que um profissional seja o responsável técnico pela obra.
    Manter a documentação da obra arquivada.

Requisitos

  • I. Requisitos Técnicos e Legais
    • Conhecimento da NBR 16.280: É obrigatório que o síndico conheça a fundo a norma que trata da Gestão de Reformas em Edificações.
    • Noções Básicas de Construção Civil: capacidade de ler e interpretar plantas simples, entender orçamentos, cronogramas e etapas.
    • Domínio do Código Civil (Obras): conhecer os quóruns de aprovação de obras (Artigos 1.341 a 1.343).
    • Habilidade em Análise de Documentos: analisar e arquivar corretamente ARTs, RRTs, laudos de inspeção, contratos e garantias.
    • Gestão de Contratos: conhecer aspectos essenciais de contratos de empreitada/serviço.
  • II. Requisitos de Gestão e Administrativos
    • Organização e Método: gerar e controlar documentação, orçamentos e cronogramas.
    • Rigor Financeiro: elaborar previsões orçamentárias detalhadas e controlar desembolsos.
    • Planejamento Estratégico: priorizar obras de manutenção preventiva e planejar projetos de longo prazo.
    • Transparência: garantir clareza na seleção de fornecedores e prestação de contas.
  • III. Requisitos Comportamentais (Perfil)
    • Liderança e Proatividade: contratar consultorias, realizar cotações e manter preventivas.
    • Capacidade de Comunicação: informar moradores sobre impacto e dialogar com empreiteira.

Desenvolver, supervisionar e garantir a eficácia dos padrões clínicos e das intervenções baseadas em Análise do Comportamento Aplicada (ABA) na Jano Saúde, promovendo a qualidade dos atendimentos, a formação da equipe clínica e a adesão às melhores práticas com base em evidências científicas. SOBRE A FLUENCYPASS

Na Fluencypass, somos movidos por propósito, guiados por métricas e orientados por uma cultura que coloca o estudante no centro. Valorizamos ações planejadas de forma estratégica e de alto impacto. GERENTE DE RH (FOCO EM SISTEMAS DE GESTÃO)

MISSÃO DA POSIÇÃO

Ser a liderança responsável por consolidar e evoluir a área de Recursos Humanos da Fluencypass, com forte foco em Gestão de RH e Sistemas de Gestão, produzindo indicadores, análises e insights que apoiem diretamente o CEO nas decisões mais estratégicas da empresa. Essa pessoa atuará 50% estratégica e 50% tática, fortalecendo rituais, cultura, processos e a tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS

Buscamos uma pessoa com experiência sólida em Gestão de RH e Sistemas de Gestão, capaz de combinar pensamento analítico, visão sistêmica e execução prática. Alguém que atua de forma estratégica, lidera com clareza, toma decisões com responsabilidade, fortalece cultura, comunica com transparência e impulsiona a organização para alta performance.

Profissional com domínio de metodologias modernas de gestão (OKRs, Lean, PDCA, Hoshin Kanri, Design Thinking, entre outras), forte capacidade de leitura humana e habilidade para transformar dados em insights acionáveis. Precisa ter vivência em People Analytics, rituais de gestão e implementação de processos que sustentem crescimento, produtividade e cultura organizacional.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  1. Atuar como parceira estratégica do negócio, conectando visão sistêmica, análise crítica e foco em resultados.

  7. Desenvolver iniciativas de Employee Experience, Jornada do Colaborador, comunicação interna e cultura organizacional.

Organização nacional de grande escala, com operação multi-regional e elevada complexidade, atravessa um momento estratégico de qualificação do crescimento, com foco em consistência, previsibilidade e qualidade de decisão. Esse estágio exige elevação do padrão de gestão, maior integração entre estratégia e execução e uso rigoroso de dados como base decisória.

É nesse contexto que buscamos um(a) Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) . A cadeira é central para organizar a agenda comercial, sustentar a execução em múltiplas regiões e modelos de negócio e assegurar decisões ancoradas em disciplina, governança de performance e leitura econômica.

Como CCO, a missão será estruturar e conduzir a estratégia comercial de forma integrada, traduzindo direcionamentos em planos executáveis e decisões bem priorizadas, com liderança madura sobre uma estrutura executiva ampla e impacto direto na previsibilidade de resultados e na sustentabilidade do negócio.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir a agenda estratégica do negócio comercial, conectando leitura aprofundada de mercado, posicionamento competitivo, proposta de valor, pricing e canais;
  • Traduzir direcionamentos estratégicos em planos executáveis, com prioridades claras, sequenciamento lógico e acompanhamento rigoroso;
  • Estabelecer critérios de priorização e alocação de recursos, assegurando foco em um ambiente de alta complexidade;
  • Consolidar a gestão orientada por dados como base das decisões executivas, garantindo qualidade, consistência e leitura crítica dos indicadores;
  • Implantar e sustentar ritos de gestão que assegurem ritmo, disciplina e previsibilidade de resultados;
  • Liderar diretamente uma estrutura executiva ampla, incluindo diretores regionais e frentes corporativas;
  • Desenvolver lideranças, estabelecer padrões de gestão e garantir alinhamento entre estratégia central e execução regional;
  • Atuar como ponto de integração entre frentes corporativas e regionais, assegurando coerência estratégica e clareza decisória;
  • Conduzir decisões comerciais com visão econômica integrada, considerando impactos em capex, opex, margem e retorno;
  • Promover a evolução organizacional por meio da revisão de estruturas, processos e modelos, com postura analítica e investigativa.

Qualificações

  • Trajetória executiva em ambientes complexos, com operações de escala, múltiplas unidades ou atuação multi-regional;
  • Experiência em negócios de serviços, tecnologia, infraestrutura, consumo recorrente ou mercados correlatos, com forte interface entre estratégia e execução;
  • Histórico consistente de liderança de estruturas executivas amplas e responsabilidade direta por decisões e resultados;
  • Forte atuação com dados, inteligência de mercado e métricas de performance como base decisória;
  • Capacidade de estruturar problemas complexos, priorizar iniciativas e sustentar execução disciplinada;
  • Leitura econômica apurada e conforto para tomar decisões com informação incompleta, assumindo responsabilidade por riscos e impactos;
  • Vivência prévia em consultoria estratégica ou atuação equivalente será considerada diferencial relevante.
  • Disponibilidade para residir em São Paulo - SP

description:
About the Role

A fast-growing distributor company is seeking an experienced and strategic Head of Supply Chain to lead end-to-end operations across the North American region. This position is based out of the Bethlehem, PA, corporate office.

The Senior Director of Supply Chain is responsible for ensuring supply continuity, optimizing cost and inventory, and driving service excellence across a diverse and purpose-led portfolio. The successful candidate will bring strategic thinking, work closely with vendor partners, commercial teams, and national functions to enable scalable growth. This leader has the responsibility for delivering exceptional supply chain performance across all direct and indirect categories, and wins the confidence of vendors to select the company as their primary distributor in all territories.

Responsibilities

  • Lead supply chain operations for the North American region, including demand/supply planning, category, and inventory management
  • Own and drive the S&OP process, ensuring alignment between supply and commercial teams
  • Optimize performance across distribution, warehousing
  • Manage third-party suppliers and manufacturing partners for service, quality, and compliance
  • Support new product introductions and market expansions
  • Collaborate with global teams on digital supply chain initiatives and system improvements
  • Lead and develop a lean, high-performing supply chain team

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of supply chain experience, including leadership roles within CPG, Consumable dated products
  • Must have distribution center experience
  • Willing to relocate or live in the Lehigh Valley

Required Skills

  • Proven success managing procurement, inventory planning, and delivering improvements in fill rate, productivity, cost savings/avoidance, and driving revenue growth
  • Strong working knowledge of ERP and planning systems
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration, supplier management, and problem-solving skills
  • Experience in distribution within Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Distribution, overseeing multiple remote distributions.

Seniority level

  • Executive

Employment type

  • Full-time

Job function

  • Distribution

Industries
